name: Natalia Scaliter
headline: Managing Director Google Cloud Argentina, Paraguay and Uruguay - Member of Women Corporate Director (WCD)
about:
Managing Director at Google Cloud with a proven track record of driving corporate strategy, operational excellence, and regional scale across the Southern Cone.
Throughout my career in the technology industry, I have specialized in guiding complex organizations through fundamental business model transformations. My approach combines macro-strategic reflection with robust execution, helping enterprises leverage cutting-edge innovation to unlock new revenue streams and achieve sustainable market expansion.
I bring to board-level conversations a deep understanding of digital ecosystems, technological risk management, and the strategic agility required to lead in emerging markets. Open to Non-Executive Director (NED) and Board Advisory roles where digital vision, regional market expertise, and long-term strategic planning are critical to driving enterprise value.
